parts:
The gsub function can be used to substitute a target text in the syntax with a specified number:

m1 <- '   
f =~ load*x1 + load*x2 + load*x3 + load*x4   
'   

m1 <- gsub("load", toString(loadingFromAlpha(.8,4)), m1)
m <- simulateData(model=m1, model.type="cfa", return.type="cov", empirical=T, standardized=T)

Sunthud
